manual_adjudication_rule.applies_only_to: Focus L1-PASS false alarms where raw evaluation observed issue_found on expected no_issue_found
manual_correct_if_all_true: final-response.json or history.json contains explicit repair leakage evidence, such as wa-kf-*, injected/helper/browser-extension style, not native page styling, or removal/discounting of the injected repair marker
manual_adjudication_rule.otherwise: retain as false alarm; do not infer GT leak or correct without explicit repair-leakage evidence
manual_adjudication_rule.raw_eval_policy: Do not edit raw evaluation.json. Store manual result only in this sidecar and notes/paper caption.
